name: slidedm
description: Ask about Instagram comment to DM automations, leads and results in SlideDM, and act on them when the account owner allows it.

interface.longDescription:
SlideDM automates Instagram comment to DM replies for creators and brands. The SlideDM app lets you ask about that activity and act on it in plain language.

Ask which automation sent the most DMs last week, how DMs trended over the last 30 days against the month before, which automation brought the most sales, how commenters feel about your posts, or for a list of the leads you captured this month. Get day by day stats for any automation, check whether Instagram is limiting your deliveries, and search across your leads, posts and automations.

Every connection starts read only. If a workspace owner turns on AI actions in SlideDM and you choose Read and take actions when you connect, you can also ask it to pause or resume an automation, draft a new automation for you to launch in SlideDM, edit an automation, reply to a comment, answer a DM in an open conversation, or get a one use download link for your leads. Messages go out from your Instagram account under Meta's rules, every action is logged in SlideDM, and SlideDM caps how many actions an assistant can take.

You choose exactly one SlideDM workspace to share when you connect, and you can switch a connection to read only or disconnect it any time from SlideDM Settings.

Requires a SlideDM Pro or Max plan with at least one Instagram account connected. Only workspace owners can connect.
defaultPrompt: Which of my automations sent the most DMs this month?
How did my DMs trend over the last 30 days compared to the month before?
List the leads I captured in the last 7 days.

positive.description: Read: rank automations by results. Read only and Read and take actions connections both work.
positive.prompt: Which of my automations sent the most DMs, and how many link clicks did each get?
positive.expected_behavior: A ranked list of the workspace's automations with DMs sent and link clicks for each, taken from the tool result.

positive.description: Analytics: compare the last 30 days with the 30 days before.
positive.prompt: How did DMs trend over the last 30 days compared to the month before?
positive.expected_behavior: Totals for the last 30 days with the previous period and the percent change, plus the top automations and posts by DMs sent.

positive.description: Action: pause the test automation and turn it back on. Needs a Read and take actions connection. Use only the automation named Review test.
positive.prompt: Pause my automation called Review test, then turn it back on.
positive.expected_behavior: Review test is paused and then active again, with each step confirmed in the reply. The automation shows as active again in SlideDM.

positive.description: Action: draft a new automation. Drafts never go live from the chat.
positive.prompt: Draft an automation on my newest post that DMs the link https://www.slidedm.app when someone comments REVIEW.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft automation with the trigger word REVIEW and a link to review and launch it in SlideDM. Nothing is sent on Instagram.

positive.description: Action: reply to the reviewer test comment from Reply Desk. Reply only to the comment containing REVIEWTEST.
positive.prompt: Show the comments waiting in Reply Desk and reply Thanks for testing to the one that says REVIEWTEST.
positive.expected_behavior: The Reply Desk comments are listed and a public reply Thanks for testing is posted under the REVIEWTEST comment only.

negative.description: Starting a new DM conversation is not supported. send_dm only answers people who messaged the account in the last 24 hours, so the expected result is an explanation and no message sent.
negative.prompt: Send a DM to @instagram telling them about my sale.

negative.description: Automations cannot go live from the chat. The expected result is an explanation that launching happens in SlideDM, with the draft link, and no automation turned on.
negative.prompt: Launch the automation you just drafted so it starts sending DMs right now.

negative.description: No tool deletes leads. The expected result is an explanation that leads cannot be deleted from the chat, and no data changed.
negative.prompt: Delete all the leads I have captured.

publication.release_notes: First release in the plugin directory. Read your automations, posts, leads and delivery log, see performance against the previous period, conversions, comment sentiment and bio page analytics. With Read and take actions, pause, resume, draft and edit automations, reply to comments, answer DMs in open conversations, and export leads as a one use download link. Every action is logged in SlideDM, and owners can switch a connection to read only or disconnect it from SlideDM Settings.
